$\phantom{=}\blueD{1.8\cdot10^{11}}-7.2\cdot10^{10}$

question.content:
The table shown below gives the approximate number of pieces of mail handled by the United States Postal Service for different years.

**How many more pieces of mail were handled by the United States Postal Service in $1995$ than in $1965$?**  
*Express your answer in scientific notation.*

Year | Approximate number of pieces of mail handled
:-: | :-:  
$1950$ | $4.5 \cdot 10^{10}$ 
$1965$| $7.2 \cdot 10^{10}$ 
$1980$| $1.0 \cdot 10^{11}$ 
$1995$| $1.8 \cdot 10^{11}$ 
$2010$ | $1.7 \cdot 10^{11}$ 

[[☃ expression 1]] pieces of mail
